import json

def check_val(val):
    if val in [None, "", "null"]:
        return "N/A"
    if isinstance(val, str):
        return val.replace("\\", "\\\\")
    return val

def sanitize_for_deepseek(val):
    if val in [None, "", "null"]:
        return "N/A"
    if isinstance(val, str):
        # Reemplaza backslashes por forward slashes
        return val.replace("\\", "/")
    return val

# 1) Coge el JSON inyectado por Shuffle como raw string
raw = r"""$create_startnode"""

# 2) Lo parseamos a un dict de Python
data = json.loads(raw)

# 3) Extraemos los campos necesarios
file_hash        = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("data", {}).get("file_hash")
endpoint         = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("data", {}).get("endpoint")
hostname         = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("predecoder", {}).get("hostname")
timestamp        = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("predecoder", {}).get("timestamp")
rule_description = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("rule", {}).get("description")
rule_level       = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("rule", {}).get("level")
title            = data.get("title")
file_path        = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("data", {}).get("file_path")
full_log         = data.get("all_fields", {}).get("full_log")

# 4) Creamos el output normalizado
result = {
    # Para IRIS
    "file_hash_normalized_for_iris":     check_val(file_hash),
    "endpoint_normalized_for_iris":      check_val(endpoint),
    "hostname_normalized_for_iris":      check_val(hostname),
    "timestamp_normalized_for_iris":     check_val(timestamp),
    "rule_description_normalized_for_iris": check_val(rule_description),
    "rule_level_normalized_for_iris":    check_val(rule_level),
    "title_normalized_for_iris":         check_val(title),
    "file_path_normalized_for_iris":     check_val(file_path),

    # Para DeepSeek (sin backslashes conflictivos)
    "file_path_for_deepseek":            sanitize_for_deepseek(file_path),
    "full_log_for_deepseek":             sanitize_for_deepseek(full_log),
    "rule_description_for_deepseek":    sanitize_for_deepseek(rule_description),
    "title_for_deepseek":                sanitize_for_deepseek(title),


    "success": True
}

# 5) Imprimimos el output para que lo capture Shuffle
print(json.dumps(result))

import json
import html

# 1) Verificamos si la ejecución fue exitosa
status_raw = r"""$http_1.success"""
if status_raw.lower() != "true":
    # Timeout o error de conexión
    print("API for deepSeek model  has failed when creating the email. Please write it manually and deny the email sending clicking the red button at the bottom.")
else:
    # 2) Recibe el contenido generado por la IA como raw string
    raw = r"""$http_1.body.choices.#0.message.content"""

    # 3) Limpieza básica del bloque ```html ... ```
    def clean_content(text):
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            return "N/A"

        # Quitar delimitadores ```html al principio y ``` al final, si existen
        text = text.strip()
        if text.startswith("```html"):
            text = text[7:].lstrip()
        if text.endswith("```"):
            text = text[:-3].rstrip()
        return text

    # 4) Genera el resultado limpio
    cleaned = clean_content(raw)

    # 5) Resultado que se puede usar en el email final
    print(cleaned)

import json

def check_val(val):
    if val in [None, "", "null"]:
        return "N/A"
    if isinstance(val, str):
        return val.replace("\\", "\\\\")
    return val

# Captura directa del JSON de Shuffle
raw = r"""$hybrid_analisis.body"""

try:
    data = json.loads(raw)

    # Extrae campos del dict directamente
    filename = data.get("submissions", [{}])[0].get("filename")
    environment_description = data.get("environment_description")
    type_ = data.get("type")
    verdict = data.get("verdict")
    mitre_attck = data.get("mitre_attcks", [{}])[0].get("tactic")
    mitre_technique = data.get("mitre_attcks", [{}])[0].get("technique")
    attack_id_wiki = data.get("mitre_attcks", [{}])[0].get("attck_id_wiki")
    attack_id = data

    result = {
        "filename_normalized": check_val(filename),
        "environment_description_normalized": check_val(environment_description),
        "type_normalized": check_val(type_),
        "verdict_normalized": check_val(verdict),
        "mitre_attack_normalized": check_val(mitre_attck),
        "mitre_technique_normalized": check_val(mitre_technique),
        "attack_id_wiki_normalized": check_val(attack_id_wiki),
        "attack_id_normalized": check_val(attack_id),
        "success": True
    }

except Exception as e:
    result = {
        "success": False,
        "message": f"Exception: {str(e)}"
    }

print(json.dumps(result))

import json

raw_outer = r"""$receive_raw_information.information"""

# Intentamos decodificar escapes (para limpiar dobles escapes)
try:
    decoded_once = raw_outer.encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
except Exception:
    decoded_once = raw_outer

# Intentamos parsear el JSON ya decodificado
try:
    data = json.loads(decoded_once)
    error = None
except Exception as e:
    data = {}
    error = str(e)

# Extraemos los valores con fallback
html_info = data.get("information", "No information provided.")
email_sender = data.get("emailSender", "")
email_receiver = data.get("emailReceiver", "")

# Empaquetamos TODO para imprimirlo en un solo print
result = {
    "raw_outer": raw_outer,
    "decoded_once": decoded_once,
    "parsed_data": data,
    "html": html_info,
    "emailSender": email_sender,
    "emailReceiver": email_receiver,
    "error": error
}

print(json.dumps(result))
